vectors.description: A shifted second marker stays a sibling of a first list counting from 1.

vectors.name: right-aligned-three
vectors.description: Three right-aligned markers form one list.

vectors.description: A numbering restart does not continue the first list.

vectors.name: same-column
vectors.description: Markers at the same column form one list.

vectors.name: numbering-gap
vectors.description: A gap in numbering is not a continuation.
